reviewer_scope: Read-only visual and runtime QA of currently built ADJ, CHAUVET DJ, Eliminator Lighting, Eurolite, SHEHDS, and Showtec assets in the parent expansion worktree.

method.visual_pairs: Viewed each stored official product-reference image beside its rendered three-quarter preview. Rechecked Focus Spot 6Z, Phantom 100 Spot and Eurolite KLS-120; added a source/render review of Intimidator Spot Duo.
method.runtime_checks: Compared documented fixture dimensions to exported USDZ bounds in fixture.json and reviewed articulated-part/joint metadata and generated runtime rig sidecars where present.
method.limitations: This is a visual/source comparison, not physical measurement, DMX bench testing, RealityKit testing, or a check of entries that remain in research/blocked state.

summary.documented_dimensions_match_exported_bou: All 16 reviewed fixtures match each documented outer axis within approximately 0.000001 m.
summary.articulated_moving_heads: Intimidator Spot Duo runtime sidecar defines separate pan/tilt chains and emitters for both heads. KLS-120 runtime sidecar defines four individual head pivots and emitters; these are manually aimable fixed spots, not moving-head joints. Other previously reviewed moving heads retain their prior QA status.

findings.observation: The updated preview now shows a longer angular/tapered housing that follows the product reference's overall shell silhouette and dimensions. It remains a procedural approximation and omits finer shell transitions, ventilation detail and exact surface contours, but the previous material silhouette mismatch is resolved.
findings.concrete_fix: No further material correction requested; optional refinement could add source-visible venting and shell transitions without changing the documented envelope.

findings.observation: The latest preview reduces the front ring/optic by approximately 23%; its angular shell, tapered profile and smaller face now read consistently with the official reference within the documented outer envelope. Fine housing transitions and connector/vent details remain approximations.
findings.concrete_fix: No further substantive geometry correction requested. Preserve the documented envelope; remaining contour, lens treatment and surface details are procedural approximations, not manufacturer CAD.
